text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. As part of my trainer duties,
I had to entertain some racing world dignitaries.
After dinner, we were heading to karaoke, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's the matter?
Sighing that heavily.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So you're doing karaoke hospitality for some fussy higher-ups, huh?
choice_data_list: I'm worried I won't be able to hype everyone up properly...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, dunno if it'll actually help, but...
Wanna learn anyway?
I can teach you how to hype up a crowd, straight from my family's snack bar.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hype Lesson 1!
"He who mocks the maracas shall weep by the maracas!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
An essential item to hype up the crowd!
...Though depending on how you wave it, the sound changes, and missing the beat turns it into pure noise, so be careful.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The trick to swinging it isn't just with your wrist,
it's feeling it with your whole arm.
Like this—swish, swish, swish!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, no need to say it out loud!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hype Lesson 2!
"Mind their generation for duets, but don't overthink it!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Considering their age group,
the songs you're picking right now are totally
on point, Trainer, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I've still got plenty of youth in me, you know!"
...is how they feel, so...
Maybe a hit song from about five years ago would be a good pick?
choice_data_list: A-Amazing! How did you even know that...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: When you grow up listening to customers sing karaoke at your family's place, you end up learning all kinds of songs.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah! If you end up singing solo,
be considerate to your partner
and avoid choosing this year's biggest mainstream hits.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Everyone always wants to sing whatever's trending right now. You wanna avoid picking the same song as someone else, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, then again, if it's too obscure of a song,
it won't get the crowd hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How about I pick out a few songs for now?
Some nice tracks that won't overlap and'll hype everyone up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thoroughly practicing call-and-response and prepping the songs to sing helped clear up a lot of my anxiety about entertaining clients.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're a quick study.
My, my, truly impressive.
choice_data_list: Doctor, please teach me any other techniques you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Anything else? Uhh, in that case...
.........

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-Well... the rest comes down to practice. ...Like rehearsing the duet, for instance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ring ring ring ring...!)
choice_data_list: Ah! We need to call for an extension--

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, no!!
I've already taught you pretty much everything, it'll be fine!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Keep doing your best just like this.
Yes, yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh! So it went well, then.
Yesterday's client karaoke, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Splendid, splendid.
It was well worth putting in an uncharacteristic amount of effort.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here, have some kumquat juice.
It's really good for your throat.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Don't mention it.
I'm just being a busybody anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You know, working adults like you, Trainer-san,
are always working hard on all sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even though things are probably tough more often than not...
They quietly keep society turning, keeping their companies afloat.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I can't just see that as someone else's problem, you know? ...You know, the kind of effort that never sees the light of day.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So, watching people like that gets me thinking.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "‘I can't let myself get discouraged either!’ like that."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I guess it's kinda my way of returning the favor~
Though it's just something I took upon myself to do."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"And with that! How about we throw a wrap party?
Any requests?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to thank her myself, but she would probably just be modest about it.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Karaoke? Are we practicing again?
choice_data_list: Because we couldn't do the duet together…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: I want us to enjoy it together, is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
~~gh... ...Just so you know,
my song choices are pretty old-school too, okay!
